title: #170 Compulsory Learning
prompt: Some people think learning a foreign language at school should be compulsory. To what extent do you agree with it? Use your experience or examples to support your viewpoint.

promptSegments.text: Some people think learning a foreign language at school should be compulsory.
To what extent do you agree with it?
Use your experience or examples to support your viewpoint.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Learning a foreign language helps students communicate with people from other places.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning a foreign language helps students communicate with people from other places.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another reason is that learning a foreign language helps students in their future jobs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another reason is that learning a foreign language helps students in their future jobs.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Learning a language in school is helpful because it allows students to learn basic phrases and communicate with people when traveling.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning a language in school is helpful because it allows students to learn basic phrases and communicate with people when traveling.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: People can learn languages better outside of school because real life provides many chances to practice speaking, leading to faster and more natural learning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: People can learn languages better outside of school because real life provides many chances to practice speaking, leading to faster and more natural learning.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Mandatory language study forces students to practice speaking and grammar regularly, significantly improving their ability to communicate in a new language.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mandatory language study forces students to practice speaking and grammar regularly, significantly improving their ability to communicate in a new language.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Mandatory study prepares students for global jobs because many companies require workers who can communicate with people from different countries.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mandatory study prepares students for global jobs because many companies require workers who can communicate with people from different countries.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Mandatory language study can cause stress for students, potentially reducing their overall motivation because they are forced to learn something they are not interested in.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Mandatory language study can cause stress for students, potentially reducing their overall motivation because they are forced to learn something they are not interested in.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Students learn better when they focus on personal interest, as this motivation turns the difficult task of learning into a fun hobby.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Students learn better when they focus on personal interest, as this motivation turns the difficult task of learning into a fun hobby.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ diễn đạt lại đề bài mà quên khẳng định rõ lập trường cá nhân ở cả mở bài và kết bài.

promptTraps.en: Avoid memorized generic templates; ensure every body paragraph contains concrete reasoning and evidence.
promptTraps.vi: Tránh các câu rập khuôn học thuộc lòng; hãy đảm bảo mỗi thân bài đều có lập luận và dẫn chứng cụ thể.

faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.

faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
